## Part A : Importing and Inspecting a CSV

A1
```{r}
emp_df <- read.csv("employees.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
A2
```{r}
str(emp_df)
head(emp_df, 5)
summary(emp_df)
```
A3
```{r}
nrow(emp_df)
ncol(emp_df)
sapply(emp_df, class)

```
A4
```{r}
mean(emp_df$salary)
max(emp_df$age)
table(emp_df$department)
```
## Part B: Creating Data Frames
B1
```{r}
new_hires <- data.frame( emp_id = c(21,22,23), name = c("Uma", "Victor","Wen"), department = c("HR", "IT", "Sales"), sex = c("F", "M", "F"), age = c(28, 37, 33), salary = c(45000, 83000, 60000), years_service = c(2, 9, 6), rating = c(3,4,5), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
B2
```{r}
emp_all <- rbind(new_hires, emp_df)
dim(emp_all)
```
B3
```{r}
emp_all$bonus <-round( (0.5)*emp_all$salary)
head(emp_all)
```
## Part C : Subsetting
C1
```{r}
emp_all[1:5, c("name", "salary")]
emp_all[emp_all$salary > 7000,]
```
C3
```{r}
subset(emp_all, department == "IT" & years_service >= 5, select = c("name", "years_service", "salary"))
```
C4
```{r}

older <- which(emp_all$age > 50)
older
emp_all$name[older]

```
C5
```{r}
head(emp_all [, - which(names(emp_all) %in% c("emp_id", "bonus"))], 3)
```
C6
```{r}
emp_all$salary[emp_all$name == "Mia"]
```
## Part D

D1
```{r}
emp_all$department <- factor(emp_all$department)
emp_all$sex <- factor(emp_all$sex)
levels(emp_all$department)
levels(emp_all$sex)
```
D2
```{r}
table(emp_all$department)
table(emp_all$department, emp_all$sex)
```
D3
```{r}
emp_all$rating_level <- factor(emp_all$rating, levels = 1:5, labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent"), ordered = TRUE)
table(emp_all$rating_level)
```
D4
```{r}
for (d in levels(emp_all$department)) {
  m <- round(mean(emp_all$salary[emp_all$department == d]))
  print(paste(d, m))
}
```
## Part E : Conditional Statements

E1
```{r}
emp_all$salary_band <- ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 70000, "High", ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 50000, "Medium", "Low"))
print(table(emp_all$salary_band))
```
E2
```{r}
emp_all$level <- ifelse(emp_all$years_service >= 8, "Senior", "Junior")
print(table(emp_all$level))
```
E3
```{r}
raise_pct <- function(rating) {
  if (rating == 5) {
    0.10
  } else if (rating == 4) {
    0.07
  } else if (rating == 3) {
    0.04
  } else {
    0
  }
}

emp_all$raise <- sapply(emp_all$rating, raise_pct)
emp_all$new_salary <- round(emp_all$salary * (1 + emp_all$raise))
print(head(emp_all[, c("name", "rating", "raise", "new_salary")], 5))
```

E4

```{r}
total <- sum(emp_all$new_salary)
if (total < 1600000) {
  print("Budget OK")
} else {
  print("Over budget")
}
total
```

## Part E : Conditional Statements

F1
```{r}
head(sort(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), 5)
head(sort(emp_all$name), 5)
```
F2
```{r}
by_salary <- emp_all[order(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), ]
head(by_salary[, c("name", "department", "salary")], 5)
```
